title: Five more input pickers
blurb: A range input drawn round a dial in slices, two date inputs on one calendar with a band between the days, a colour wheel that reads its own pixels, a year of week buttons under a fisheye, and a datalist option drawn as ghost text inside an input.
question: Can one element be drawn in slices along a curve, can a canvas that draws elements read its own pixels back, and can a datalist option be drawn inside the picture of an input, with every control still a real <input>?
result: Yes to all three in Chromium 157. The hit box of a sliced element does not follow the curve, so the dial maps the pointer by hand.
